title: The Treasure Chest Filled with Fruits
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Sonoko, Masumi Sera, Inspector Megure, Detective Takagi, Yoko Okino) omitted by convention -- present throughout but not case-specific to this murder plot (Sera stages the reveal but only as Conan's mouthpiece, per the show's usual pattern). No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object). The old `cases/` file correctly named Furuya as the culprit -- no culprit discrepancy found here, unlike some other rebuilt episodes -- but it was thin: one collapsed location instead of the three distinct scenes (Kasuga's warehouse, the TV studio stage, Storage Room 3 where the killing actually happened), generic 'knows' edges instead of the actual leak/bribery/confrontation chain, no node for the rubber-tube fake-lock prop that is the entire mechanical trick of the case, no node for the champion Kurimura (the leak's actual recipient, who later confesses), and no node for presenter Kenzaki (who opens the chest on-air and discovers the body). The old file's two clues (fake lock component, apple seeds) are consolidated here into one genuinely comparative clue (security footage showing Furuya leaving empty-handed vs. the missing apples vs. the seeds later recovered from him) since the fake-lock detail is a fact about one object (the padlock/rubber-tube mechanism) and belongs in `attrs`, not a clue node. case_type: murder.

persons.name: Shotoku Takeki
persons.occupation: food critic, head judge of the show, "Legend of Sweets"

attrs.designed_the_double_lock_scheme: devised the two-padlock relay system specifically to stop the mystery fruit from being leaked
attrs.died_of: blunt force wound to the back of the head
attrs.suspicion_before_death: suspected the six-time champion Kurimura was somehow being tipped off about the mystery fruit in advance

attrs.cleared_because: seen leaving his own warehouse by two assistant directors after applying the first lock; Takeki was alive and present at that time
never personally handled the padlock himself -- delegated the locking to Furuya every time

attrs.scheme: was secretly opening the chest early each week to tip off champion Kurimura on the mystery fruit, in exchange for a cut of his prize money
attrs.trick: used a gold-painted rubber tube jammed into the padlock's hole to make it look locked while it was actually free, so he could reopen the chest without breaking the real lock and then relock it for real afterward
attrs.cover_up: hid Takeki's body inside the fruit chest, removing roughly ten apples to make room, then blended and ate the apples (seeds included) in a storage-room kitchen prop to dispose of them fast

persons.name: Shuhei Kurimura
persons.occupation: patissier, six-week reigning champion of the show

attrs.confession: confessed after the arrest to knowing the mystery fruit in advance each week

attrs.role_in_discovery: opened the final padlock live on air and discovered Takeki's body inside the chest

attrs.note: where the chest was opened live on air and the body was discovered
TV station room where the chest was kept between deliveries; the actual crime scene
where Kasuga fills the chest each week; Takeki visited here the evening before the murder

attrs.security_features: custom electronic anti-pick chip in the padlock keyhole, fridge-style airtight edge seal, raised false bottom
attrs.blood_trace: wiped-off blood found on both the inside and outside edges of the lid, showing the chest was open at the moment of the fatal blow -- pins the killing to wherever the chest physically was, i.e. Storage Room 3, not the studio

attrs.purpose: jammed into the padlock's shackle hole to fake a closed lock while leaving it free to reopen by twisting

attrs.location: Storage Room 3, marked non-smoking and normally used to store drama kitchen props

attrs.toxin: amygdalin, a cyanide-precursor found in apple seeds
attrs.recovered_from: passed later in Furuya's stool and matched to the rare mystery-fruit apple variety

clues.desc: Security footage shows Furuya leaving Storage Room 3 empty-handed, yet roughly ten apples are missing from the chest -- the gap closes when passed seeds recovered from his stool match the rare mystery apple.

edges.detail: packs the chest with the week's mystery fruit at his warehouse
removes his own first lock once the chest is back from the station, per the relay protocol
orders Furuya to hook a second padlock onto the chest and send it back
applies the real second padlock -- his standard cover after the fake-lock trick
jams the rubber tube into the padlock so it looks shut while staying free to reopen
reopens the chest each week using the fake-lock trick to see and leak the mystery fruit
tips off Kurimura on the mystery fruit in exchange for a cut of prize money
Takeki sneaks back into the TV studio disguised among period-drama extras and catches Furuya reopening the chest in Storage Room 3

edges.method: blunt force wound to the back of the head during a scuffle over the chest lid

edges.detail: hides the body inside the chest, removing roughly ten apples to make room
blends the removed apples to get rid of them quickly
drinks the blended apples without removing the seeds first
producer gives the presenter the final key to open the chest live on air
opens the chest live on air and finds Takeki's body inside

edges.motive_type: suspected_as_leak_source (red herring -- Kasuga was the only one who knew the fruit's identity, but his alibi was confirmed by staff who watched him leave and Takeki was alive after)
held_personally_responsible_for_any_leak (red herring -- weak motive, and he never personally touched the padlock)

edges.detail: his body was present at the studio inside the chest once it was carried there for filming, though he was killed at l2
